ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all general partners, limited partners, settlors, protectors, beneficial owners and authorized signatories against the Bermuda Financial Intelligence Agency published sanctions lists, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, UN Security Council Sanctions Lists, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, FATF high-risk jurisdiction list, and INTERPOL notices. Politically Exposed Persons must undergo enhanced due diligence with written source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. No anonymous nominee shareholders or bearer partnership interests are permitted. Screening must be completed no earlier than 30 days before filing and refreshed immediately prior to registration.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registry General E-Services Portal (Company & Partnership Name Reservation through the Registrar of Companies), accessible via https://www.gov.bm/company-registration
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the sole official language of registration. The partnership name must be in Latin script and must contain the words 'Limited Partnership' or 'L.P.' (or the applicable exempted limited partnership suffix) unless otherwise authorized by the Registrar. Names with diacritical marks or non-English characters require a transliteration into standard English alphabet approved by the Registrar of Companies.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of a name rejection, the applicant must file a formal written appeal to the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds of objection and any supporting argument that the proposed name is not misleading, deceptive, or contrary to public policy. The Registrar must issue a determination within 21 days. An adverse determination may be appealed to the Supreme Court of Bermuda under the relevant provisions of the Limited Partnership Act 1883 and the Companies Act 1981. Name reservations may be renewed by fresh filing before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted. An Exempted Limited Partnership must maintain a registered office physically located in Bermuda, staffed by a licensed registered office provider or certified corporate services provider, capable of receiving and recording legal process and official notices. A virtual-only address, mail-forwarding box, or shared non-staffed address is insufficient for statutory compliance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For this ISIC 6201 data-pipeline commerce-scraping business model, the quantified risk of an unannounced physical on-site inspection is approximately 15% per fiscal year in the ordinary course of economic substance verification. The probability increases to 40% where operational records, accounting documents, or management decisions are claimed to originate in Bermuda, or where the partnership is selected by the Bermuda Competent Authority for economic substance review under the Economic Substance Act 2018.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2014 (as amended), ss.4-7, 8-12, 13-17, 23-26; Companies Act 1981 (as amended) applicable to corporate general partners; Partnership (Limited) Act 1883 for residual principles not inconsistent with the 2014 Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Bermuda Registry of Companies, Government Administration Building, 30 Parliament Street, Hamilton HM 12, Bermuda.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application to Register an Exempted Limited Partnership and Declaration of General Partner (Form ELP-01), filed under the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2014.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies. The ELP must declare its intended aggregate capital contribution. Contributions may be unfunded at formation and are governed by the Partnership Agreement. No escrow or capital-deposit account is required by statute.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Resolved that the Partnership be registered as an Exempted Limited Partnership under the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2014. Resolved that [General Partner Name] be appointed as General Partner and [Limited Partner Name] be admitted as Initial Limited Partner. Resolved that the registered office be established at [Bermuda Registered Office Address] and that such office provider be retained. Resolved that the General Partner be authorized to execute and file all formation documents, open bank accounts, appoint legal counsel, and procure all requisite licences. Resolved that the Partnership Agreement annexed to this resolution be adopted, and that books and records be maintained in Bermuda.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Registry of Companies, Name Clearance Section, via e-Registry portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for name clearance for the proposed ELP. Provide two alternative names. The registry verifies the proposed name is not identical or deceptively similar to an existing entity and does not imply government connection. After clearance, reserve the name for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation of corporate General Partner (if applicable)
Copy of passport and proof of address of individual General Partner or beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name clearance is refused, submit a written appeal or file an alternative name. The Registry may suggest a modified name. Refiling is permitted without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and execute the Partnership Agreement and prepare Formation File
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda legal counsel, notarial officer, and General Partner.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Exempted Limited Partnership Agreement setting out capital contributions, profit sharing, management powers, transferability of partnership interests, and dissolution events. Execute the agreement by all partners or certify signature pages. Obtain certified passport and utility bill for each partner. Prepare the declarations required by the 2014 Act, including the General Partner's certificate that the partnership will not carry on business with the public in Bermuda.
required_dossiers: Draft CO-2 Declaration confirmed from Gateway
Certificate of Compliance from General Partner
Certified charter and register of directors of General Partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry requests corrections, revise and re-execute the affected schedules within 5 days. Notarial errors are cured by supplementary execution and new certified copies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File ELP registration application with the Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Registry of Companies, Filing Department.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form ELP-01, the Declaration of General Partner, the Partnership Agreement, and all supporting dossiers to the Registry. Pay the official filing fee. On successful review, the Registry issues the Certificate of Registration in the name of the ER. Verify that the issued certificate reflects the exact proposed entity name.
required_dossiers: Form ELP-01 signed by all partners
Declaration of General Partner under s.8(2) of the 2014 Act
Registered office address consent from Bermuda corporate services provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query, respond within 10 days with a covering letter. Correct any inconsistent information in Form ELP-01 and resubmit. The Registry may accept a corrected declaration rather than requiring a fresh filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration gazette publication and initial statutory filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Registry of Companies and Bermuda Official Gazette.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Certificate of Registration, cause a notice of formation to be published in the Bermuda Official Gazette. File the certificate with the Registrar. Complete the registered office questionnaire and beneficial ownership register under the Beneficial Ownership Act.
required_dossiers: Draft Gazette notice prepared by counsel
Beneficial ownership register initial filing (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Gazette notice is delayed, apply for late publication with an explanatory affidavit. Registry may accept a late publication upon payment of a late fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bermuda Ministry of Economy and Labour (not a licensing authority for remote software services).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating licence required for a public commercial web scraping and proxy API gateway service because the activity is a remote digital service conducted through cloud infrastructure, not a physical establishment in Bermuda.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Bermuda Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no physical facility, no industrial emissions, and no land disturbance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No applicable wastewater, VOC, or solid waste standards because the ELP has no physical establishment or manufacturing activity. Any data-centre operations are located and regulated in the hosting jurisdiction and are not part of the Bermuda entity's licensing scope.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety certificate, structural inspection, or workplace health clearance is required. If a minimal administrative office is later established in Bermuda, the general partner must consult the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service and obtain a valid employer's liability certificate, but this is not a condition precedent to formation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda (British Overseas Territory outside the UK VAT area): (1) Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance - entity registration, partnership certificates; (2) Office of the Tax Commissioner - sole competent tax authority for the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 / Tax Administration Act 2024 (CIT, Pillar Two/GLoBE), filing via the Government of Bermuda online tax portal; (3) Bermuda Customs Department - customs duty, consignee codes, Asycuda World electronic declarations; (4) Payroll Tax Office - employer registration for Bermuda-based staff. UK HMRC is not the competent tax authority for the Bermuda ELP; UK VAT/HMRC rules apply only to UK customer-facing supplies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: appoint a Bermuda-registered agent and file with the Registrar of Companies under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2017 to register the ELP; obtain the Certificate of Registration and unique partnership registration number, which serves as the de facto tax reference. Step 2: if the ELP is a constituent entity of an MNE group with consolidated revenue of EUR 750m or more in at least two of the four preceding fiscal years, register each Bermuda constituent entity with the Tax Commissioner for CIT within the statutory registration window and obtain a CIT profile/taxpayer number through the online tax portal. Step 3: if the ELP employs individuals working in Bermuda, register as an employer with the Payroll Tax Office (no registration needed for remote or non-Bermudian staff). Step 4: no VAT ID exists or is required (Bermuda has no VAT/GST); the same registration number supports any Bermuda Customs consignee code application if physical imports occur.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible - the ELP is fiscally transparent under Bermuda law; Bermuda imposes no general corporate income tax, and under the CIT Act 2023 the ELP is a flow-through entity for GLoBE/Pillar Two purposes (CIT attributed to partners, subject to Bermuda permanent-establishment rules). The ELP is not a Tax_Exempt_Zone entity; ordinary territorial scope applies for CIT only if the parent MNE group exceeds the EUR 750m threshold. The Economic Substance Act 2018 relevant-activity filings are generally not triggered by web-scraping/API data services unless the activity is re-characterized as IP or financing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No Bermuda domestic 'check-the-box' election - partnership transparency is mandatory. For U.S. federal tax purposes, the ELP may file Form 8832 to elect entity classification (default: partnership). Under the CIT Act 2023, in-scope groups may elect GLoBE transitional safe harbours, the substance-based income exclusion (SBIE), the Qualified Refundable Tax Credit (QRTC) regime, and any enacted transitional CIT deferral options for the 2025-2026 transition years. No hybrid-mismatch election exists under Bermuda domestic law; hybrid arrangements are tested under investor-jurisdiction rules (e.g., UK/US anti-hybrid legislation).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None - Bermuda imposes no VAT, no GST and no sales/use tax; the only indirect taxes are import customs duties (Customs Tariff Act 1966, as amended), stamp duty and land tax, none of which attach to exported digital services. UK VAT (headline 20%) does not extend to Bermuda and is relevant only to UK customer-facing supplies made by the ELP (B2B reverse charge for UK VAT-registered customers; mandatory UK VAT registration for B2C digital supplies to UK consumers from the first supply, as the GBP 85,000 threshold does not apply to non-UK established suppliers).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - Bermuda has no VAT/GST registration threshold. For tangible imports, a business must obtain a Bermuda Customs consignee code; duty is assessed per tariff line on the c.i.f. value (rates generally 0% to 25%+ by classification). Digital services, API subscriptions and data-pipeline exports are outside the customs duty net.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None - Bermuda imposes no real-time fiscal clearance, no e-invoicing pre-clearance, no API tax clearance and no digital stamping. Bermuda Customs processes import/export declarations electronically via Asycuda World; in-scope CIT filers submit through the Tax Commissioner's online portal from fiscal year 2025. The ELP may issue ordinary commercial invoices; no fiscal invoice numbering or tax-control stamps are required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - there is no VAT/GST in Bermuda, so no zero-rating claim exists. Export of web-scraping/API gateway services from the Bermuda ELP is outside the Bermuda tax net and requires no export licence or fiscal approval. UK customer interface: (i) B2B supplies to UK VAT-registered persons are outside UK VAT scope (reverse charge on the UK customer); (ii) B2C supplies of digital services to UK consumers trigger mandatory UK VAT registration by the ELP (no threshold applies to non-UK suppliers) with UK VAT at 20% unless the service is outside scope. Bermuda imposes no foreign-exchange repatriation deadline (exchange controls abolished effective 2022/2023); the 180-day parameter retained in this dossier is a pipeline harmonization convention, not a Bermuda statutory requirement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No customs or tax clearance documents are required for the export of pure digital services (web-scraping API / data pipeline) from Bermuda; no customs export declaration arises.
Recommended audit-trail bundle: executed API/software subscription agreement stating the place of supply, commercial invoice, and API usage/delivery logs.
Payment substantiation: Stripe settlement statements or USDC/USDT on-chain transaction hashes matched to commercial invoices (supports customer-side input VAT recovery and AML record-keeping).
If tangible media were ever exported (not the current model): Bermuda Customs export declaration (Asycuda World), commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading / airway bill.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No Bermuda VAT zero-rating clawback is possible (no VAT regime). For in-scope CIT groups, the Tax Administration Act 2024 imposes civil penalties (failure to register, per-day late-filing penalties, incorrect returns), interest on underpaid CIT, and criminal sanctions for fraudulent evasion; partners of the ELP may bear joint and several liability for applicable CIT obligations. For UK VAT exposure (B2C digital supplies to UK consumers), HMRC may assess VAT for up to 4 years (20 years for deliberate concealment), impose penalties up to 100% of the VAT (FA 2007/2009 regimes), charge default interest, and cancel the registration; wrongful zero-rating or failure to register is high-risk given the Stripe/USDC payment rails leave a complete digital audit footprint.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) is the sole public authority entrusted with currency management, foreign exchange control, and banking supervision under the Exchange Control Act 1972, the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999, and the Bermuda Monetary Authority Act 1969. The Bank of England does not exercise a supervisory or exchange-control mandate over Bermuda as a British Overseas Territory.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Bermuda operates a liberalised exchange-control regime. The Bermuda dollar is pegged 1:1 to the US dollar. For an Exempted Limited Partnership designated as 'non-resident' for exchange-control purposes, capital and current account convertibility is effectively full: capital contributions, operational receivables, and investment returns may be denominated and settled in USD/GBP/EUR without BMA licensing. Profit remittances and partnership distributions enjoy unrestricted outward transfer once the partnership maintains separate non-resident foreign-currency accounts and complies with the BMA's periodic reporting and anti-money-laundering record-keeping obligations. Residual hurdles are confined to Bermuda-dollar domestic accounts used by local resident entities, where approval may be required for payments to non-residents or conversions exceeding prescribed thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There exists no mandatory export-proceeds surrender rule in Bermuda. Export receipts invoiced in foreign currency may be retained in approved foreign-currency accounts without conversion to Bermuda dollars. The BMA does not prescribe a statutory timeline, conversion ratio, or surrender quota for non-resident exempted partnerships. Where the partnership transacts in Bermuda dollars with local residents, the BMA may require documentation and consent, but no forced conversion or surrender is applicable. Exempted partnerships should nonetheless preserve invoices, payment confirmations, and route ledgers to evidence the non-resident character of the underlying transactions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI viability is rated High for operational treasury and transactional settlement, but Low for escrowed capital holding in a Bermuda regulated context. Because Bermuda does not issue e-money licences under domestic law, UK FCA-authorised EMIs and EU PSD2-authorised EMIs may provide cross-border multi-currency IBAN services to the exempted partnership under the Business Conduct (Banks and Deposit Companies) Exemption Order or the business activity/solicitation carve-outs. Such EMIs must remain outside the scope of 'deposit-taking' and cannot hold Bermuda-dollar balances for Bermuda residents. The BMA requires that no unlicensed provider holds funds on behalf of a Bermuda-regulated entity; accordingly, the ELP should utilise EMI only as a float/fee collector with onward sweep to a tier-1 bank. If USDC payment rails are used, the EMI/VASP must be either Bermuda licensed under the Digital Asset Business Act 2018 or a recognised/registered crypto service provider in an equivalent FATF jurisdiction, with segregated stablecoin reserves and independent audit attestation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bermuda does not statutorily mandate that all directors or partners appear physically in Bermuda for bank onboarding. The general partner of the ELP and each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) with 10% or more ownership interest must complete a criminalised customer due diligence process. In practice, major Bermudian banks require at least one authorised signatory to appear via live video-conference interview, with identity and address verified using qualified remote e-IDV providers meeting eIDAS/BMA guidelines. Fully remote opening is available through licensed corporate service providers (CSPs) or an accredited introducer, but certified copies of the general partner's certificate, register of limited partners, partnership agreement, incumbency certificate, and passport must be apostilled or legalised. A typical onboarding timeline is three to five weeks, with enhanced documentation and source-of-funds evidence required for partnerships utilising crypto or proxy-gateway revenues.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bermuda offshore jurisdiction with perceived low substance and no physical board presence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the ELP registration certificate, BMA non-resident exchange-control authorisation, registered-office lease/service contract, local general partner appointment deed, observer or local director appointment letter, substance declaration listing employees and premise access, audited financial statements or accountant's comfort letter, and a conservative economic-substance memorandum demonstrating that the partnership has the required governance and corporate housekeeping in place.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commercial web-scraping and proxy-API gateway activities flagged as higher risk for data integrity, privacy infringement, and IP/copyright misuse.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Obtain a legal opinion from UK or Bermuda counsel confirming that the scraping operations address only lawful public data sources, do not collect personal data without a legal basis, and do not circumvent technical protection measures. Deliver the platform's Terms of Service and Acceptable-Use policy, documentation of robots.txt compliance, log retention policy, data classification matrix showing no SNS/PII collection, ISO/IEC 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type II report, and evidence of commercially reasonable geofencing for high-risk jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex or opaque chain of ownership due to exempted partnership pass-through and non-resident ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete UBO chart with passport copies and residential proof, a signed source-of-wealth and source-of-funds questionnaire, stamped partnership register for limited partners, issued units ledger, a KYC/EDD questionnaire from the existing UK bank, bankers' reference letter from HSBC UK or Barclays, and completed sanctions/PEP screening results for every indirect owner and general partner signatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cryptocurrency (USDC) or alternative payment rails create money-laundering and sanctions-exposure concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Adopt a crypto-specific AML/KYC policy with transaction limits and wallet-screening; provide Chainalysis or TRM Labs wallet-risk ratings for all counterparties; execute FATF Travel Rule controls for transfers over USD 1,000; produce audited attestation of the stablecoin issuer's reserves; maintain complete on-chain history with signed proof-of-asset from the fiat reserve bank; and, where the ELP holds VASP licensing, submit the relevant BMA or FCA licence plus a compliance manual on sanctions filtering of the custody wallet.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions should be transmitted via SWIFT MT103 using purpose code A001 (Direct Investment) or G20 (Corporate Investment), quoting the ELP reference ELF_CUSTOM_KY_ELP. The payment should be sent from the ultimate parent's UK corporate bank account to the Bermuda bank account, with the remittance instruction referencing the executed Limited Partnership Agreement, the capital account ledger entry, and contribution schedule. The receiving Bermudian bank must be formally pre-notified of the expected transfers with the source-of-funds evidence, including a board resolution of the partner, signed capital contribution schedule, and proof of the ultimate funding source. If USDC is used for capital injection, the funds must first be converted through an FCA-registered digital asset firm or a BMA-licensed digital asset business to USD, and the fiat transfer then routed by SWIFT to the Bermudian bank, preserving the on-chain transaction hash and exchange name for verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound supplier and infrastructure disbursements should be cleared using SWIFT MT103 for individual trade obligations and SWIFT MT202/COV for the underlying correspondent bank cover payment. For high-value or recurrent API-infrastructure procurement through a Chinese or US provider, a commercial documentary letter of credit governed by UCP600 should be opened at Butterfield or HSBC Bermuda, with a confirmed advising bank in the seller's jurisdiction. Domestic Bermudian clearing utilises Bermuda's ACH/RTGS infrastructure for Bermuda-dollar payments; USD cheques and wires are settled via the correspondent banking network through the Federal Reserve's Fedwire/CHIPS; GBP payments via CHAPS; EUR payments via TARGET2. The treasury function shall maintain a payments calendar, limit order controls, and SWIFT message reconciliation to prevent settlement lags or double payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Certificate of Compliance for Exempted Limited Partnership (prescribed statutory declaration filed with the annual government fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Registry of Companies, Ministry of Finance (Government of Bermuda)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: due on or before the 30th day following each anniversary of the ELP's registration under the Limited Partnership Act 2015; for an ELP registered on 15 March, the deadline recurs on 14 April each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Overdue annual fee incurs a late-payment surcharge (generally 10% of the unpaid fee); continued default after the Registrar's statutory strike-off notice (typically three months) results in strike-off from the Register and dissolution of the ELP, requiring court-ordered restoration with arrears and costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License (ABL) application and licence fee remittance for the calendar licence year (1 January to 31 December) covering the public web scraping and proxy API gateway trading activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Licensing Authority, administered by the Tax Commissioner, Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance (Government of Bermuda)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of the licence year for a business already operating; a newly commenced business must apply within 30 days of commencement; the minimum fee band applies where annual gross revenue does not exceed BMD 100,000.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Trading without an ABL is a statutory offence punishable by fines of up to BMD 5,000 plus continuing daily penalties; late payment attracts a 10% surcharge on the licence fee; repeated default may lead the Authority to refuse renewal, requiring the ELP to cease Bermuda-regulated trading.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Declaration (ESD) - annual declaration of relevant-activity status and substance compliance; completed as a nil declaration where the data-pipeline / scraping API activity is not a specified relevant activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies acting as the Economic Substance Authority, Bermuda Registry of Companies, Ministry of Finance (Government of Bermuda)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of the ELP's financial year; for a 31 December financial year-end the ESD is due by 30 June of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing is an offence under the Economic Substance Act 2018, subject to fines of up to BMD 10,000 for a first contravention and BMD 20,000 for subsequent contraventions; continued default may additionally trigger administrative strike-off by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Register of Beneficial Ownership (ROBO) annual confirmation / update filing submitted through the Beneficial Ownership Secure Search (BOSS) portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Beneficial Ownership Section, Bermuda Registry of Companies, Ministry of Finance (Government of Bermuda)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Any transfer or acquisition of a limited partnership interest is reportable within 14 days of the change; the annual ROBO confirmation is filed together with the Certificate of Compliance within the 30-day post-anniversary window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Knowingly filing false beneficial-ownership particulars is an offence punishable by a fine of up to BMD 10,000, with imprisonment for wilful default by individuals; the Registrar may issue restriction notices barring dispositions of partnership interests and may escalate to strike-off for continuing non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for an unregulated ELP under the Limited Partnership Act 2015; no revenue or balance-sheet threshold compels an independent statutory audit. A mandatory audit arises only where the limited partnership agreement requires it, the ELP is a Bermuda Monetary Authority-regulated collective investment vehicle, or consolidated-audit obligations under a parent-company law extend to the partnership.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda has no prescribed domestic GAAP; the General Partner elects the reporting framework in the limited partnership agreement, with IFRS the prevailing choice for a cross-border technology ELP and US GAAP equally acceptable for US-connected investors; BMA-regulated funds commonly mandate IFRS or US GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The ELP must maintain a current Register of Beneficial Owners at its registered office and file each change with the Registrar's BOSS portal within 14 days of any transfer or acquisition of limited partnership interests; annually, the General Partner confirms the register remains accurate and files the confirmation with the Registrar in the same 30-day post-anniversary window as the Certificate of Compliance, with wilful omission exposing the ELP to restriction notices, fines, and strike-off.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Limited Partners (names, addresses, capital contributions, profit-share percentages, and transfer history)
Register of General Partner and its authorised signatories (appointments, resignations, and delegation records)
Minute book / register of written resolutions of the General Partner (annual approval of accounts, ABL, ESD, and ROBO confirmations)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$2,000-US$5,000 per annum for a Bermuda-licensed corporate services provider supplying registered office, resident representative, and routine annual filing support (excludes government fees and disbursements)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily mandated; a voluntary IFRS audit engagement for a small technology ELP typically ranges from US$12,000 to US$25,000; nil where the partnership agreement waives audit and the payment-processor / AML due-diligence chain accepts reviewed or unaudited accounts.
